dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Constant, linear reduction in lateral width from the mid-section towards the posterior extremity, terminating in a sharp vertex.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with low grayscale variance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: High-contrast, sharp gradient transition between the dorsal edge and the dark aquatic background.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Uniform central longitudinal dorsal ridge with no visible topological depressions or trauma-induced deformations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of subtle, low-contrast longitudinal epidermal lines or scratches visible across the dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, high-contrast dark circular blowhole orifice.
